displayDescription: A pushbroom LiDAR scan builds height-coloured returns, then an 11–13.5 m slice reveals a hidden network of 5 nodes and 5 links.
styleRenderer: SVG/HTML overlay for legend, labels and projected outline
audioDescription: Silent preview; no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Illustrative study: the point cloud is procedurally generated from a seeded PRNG, not measured LiDAR data; the RETURNS readout counts these illustrative points.
Returns are flat round sprites with no intensity/echo modelling; the beam is a translucent fan approximation.
No Blender used. Three.js bundled locally from the existing read-only node_modules (three 0.187.0) with local esbuild into vendor/three.bundle.js; no installs.

STYLE.json lists no tech.preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so the preview demonstrates the catalogue's characteristic action (scan, accumulate, slice toggle reveals hidden outline).
Project technology selection tool failed (missing PROJECT_DEPENDENCIES.json), so dependency records were not written.
